row.team_price_text: Standard: $99 USD per access-control connection/year ($149 video/intrusion/intercom)
row.evidence: Genetec's Security Center SaaS Setup Guide says 'Automatic user provisioning is only available for customers with a Security Center SaaS Premium Plan', and the pricing page shows Corporate single sign-on and Rest API only in Premium.
row.notes: Priced per connection per year (door reader, camera, intrusion panel, intercom), not per user: Standard $99 (access control) / $149 (video, intrusion, intercom); Premium $149 / $199; 1-year minimum term. June recorded 'Standard: $149/yr/device', which now matches only the Standard video/intrusion/intercom price; Standard access-control connections are $99. SCIM 2.0 provisioning works with Entra ID (P1+) and Okta, configured with Genetec GTAC on a call; SSO (OIDC only, no SAML) must be set up first. Removal from the IdP removes the user; roles are assigned in Security Center SaaS. Pricing page does not list SCIM itself, so the gate comes from the docs.

plans.name: Standard
plans.price_text: $99 USD per connection/year (access control); $149 (video, intrusion, intercom or speaker)

plans.name: Premium
plans.price_text: $149 USD per connection/year (access control); $199 (video, intrusion, intercom or speaker)
plans.notes: Includes 'Rest API' per the pricing table; whether it covers user management is undocumented.

auth.token_source: SCIM connection information is configured by Genetec GTAC during a setup call

endpoints.notes: Inferred from documented user and group provisioning; endpoint paths are not public.

operations.notes: Docs say users added to IdP groups are added and users removed from the IdP are removed; groups are provisioned. Updates and deactivation are not described separately.

roles.how: Roles are not set via SCIM; admins assign roles to SCIM-provisioned users and groups in the Security Center SaaS Configuration task.

limitations.text: Only Microsoft Entra ID (P1 or higher) or Okta are supported; setup is done with Genetec GTAC, not self-service.
Only one SCIM connection per system.
Only direct-group provisioning; no nested groups, indirect membership, guests or external users.
Invitation emails aren't sent to provisioned users; users without a role have no access.

user_api.notes: Pricing page lists 'Rest API' on Premium only; no public reference for user-management endpoints was found (Genetec ClearID has a separate identity API for cardholder data).

okta.notes: OIN search for 'genetec' returns only the Genetec Technical Assistance Portal (SWA). Provisioning uses a new Okta application configured with GTAC.

entra.notes: A new Entra Enterprise application is configured with GTAC; no gallery app page found.

google.notes: Google Workspace listed as an OIDC identity provider for sign-in only.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin listed as an OIDC identity provider for sign-in only.
